1→# Spec 043 — bop gantt: HTML polish + card hover details
     2→
     3→## Overview
     4→
     5→`bop gantt --html` generates a static HTML Gantt timeline. The current output
     6→is functional but bare. This spec adds:
     7→- Card hover tooltips showing id, stage, provider, tokens, cost, duration
     8→- Duration-based color heatmap (green=fast, yellow=medium, red=slow)
     9→- A summary statistics row below the chart
    10→- Responsive width (auto-fits to viewport without scrolling on standard screens)
    11→
    12→## Features
    13→
    14→### Hover tooltips
    15→
    16→Each Gantt bar on hover shows a floating tooltip:
    17→```
    18→id: team-arch/spec-031
    19→stage: implement
    20→provider: codex
    21→duration: 4m 22s
    22→tokens: 12,400
    23→cost: $0.18
    24→```
    25→Implemented with CSS `title` attribute or a JS `mouseover` event handler
    26→(prefer CSS-only if possible for zero-JS fallback).
    27→
    28→### Duration heatmap
    29→
    30→Color-code bars by duration percentile within the visible window:
    31→- p0–p50: `#4caf50` (green)
    32→- p50–p80: `#ff9800` (amber)
    33→- p80–p100: `#f44336` (red)
    34→
    35→Compute percentiles client-side from the data embedded in the HTML or
    36→server-side in the Rust renderer.
    37→
    38→### Summary row
    39→
    40→Below the chart, render a `<table>` with:
    41→| Metric | Value |
    42→|--------|-------|
    43→| Total cards | N |
    44→| Completed | N |
    45→| Failed | N |
    46→| Avg duration | Xm Ys |
    47→| Total cost | $X.XX |
    48→| Parallelism peak | N concurrent |
    49→
    50→### Responsive layout
    51→
    52→Set `max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto` on the chart container.
    53→The default `--html` output should look good at 1280px width without
    54→horizontal scrolling.
    55→
    56→## Acceptance Criteria
    57→
    58→- [ ] `bop gantt --html` opens in browser without JS errors
    59→- [ ] Hovering a bar shows the tooltip with card details
    60→- [ ] Bars are color-coded by duration heatmap
    61→- [ ] Summary stats table renders below chart
    62→- [ ] Page is readable at 1280px width (no horizontal scroll on main chart)
    63→- [ ] `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` clean
    64→- [ ] `cargo test` passes
    65→
    66→## Files to modify
    67→
    68→- `crates/bop-cli/src/gantt.rs` — HTML template + data embedding
